bibliographic.title: Kidnapped - On the Sea
bibliographic.author: Ally (RedTulip)
bibliographic.description:
Your arms are chained to your back, and you can still small the strong drugs that were forced under your breath.
All this happened with a walk down the shore of the beach, now far, when a rough hand pushed a damp napkin against your nose. Before you could react, you remember your eyes flickering shut.
All you saw was pure darkness. Now you need to find a way to escape.
